    • name

      protected String name()
      Description copied from class: Solver_z3_4_3
      The solver's display name for diagnostic logging. A real, overridable method rather than a field -- a field here would be hidden, not overridden, by a subclass's own same-named field (Java fields aren't polymorphic), silently binding start()'s reference to this class's value regardless of which subclass is actually running. See issue #51.
